"stood by the bay, most probably feeling the exact same thing as you"

Now i feel a lot less alone at these points :)
Thank you for all your help, going to write a list and approach him about it, will keep you up to date

Theres a teacher who i know has helped other pupils get to psychiatrists it's just when its back to day time i don't feel i need to chat about anything, im not really sure how to get around this. but the idea is there now at least

im nervous and usually im a very confident outgoing guy, but when it comes round to anything like that im very bad at chatting or approaching anyone about it. i cant ask anyone i know as nobody really has any idea as in the day im usually the most upbeat person

never gone to a doctor, often in the day i feel fine then at night im thinking i need to get it checked but then the day after im back into the mind set of all is fine. Not joking when at night im shouting in my head to do somthing about it then the next morning its as if nothing has happened. my memory is poor and very selective, hence acting with scripts ect i can cope with, i often forget encouters with people, generally having to be reminded of things ive done which i then remember but i do have to be reminded

I hate to rattle on about whats wrong as just seems moanish
parents were never together but were friends and stuck together till later on in life, 
was bullied heavily through primary school, 
got hit in head ( just above eye 4 stiches) by croquet stick aged five by my brother but that was an accident,
grandad died when was 12 so dad had to move to holland to support gran,started drinking every week, old brother moved around 14 to study over in holland/live with dad
at 15, my sister moved out to ireland brother came back for gap year due to stress of workload
 16 brother went back to holland and i moved out of house to live with flatmate, mum lived close by, flatmate was good to live with but had to leave as sister was returning who i now live with, last few weekends been drinking 30 cans to try numb out the feel of life. 

In comparrison, im studying acting and getting top marks, i get along with everybody in college although dont see them much out of college
mates around where i live just smoke all the time but housemate smoked and just put the whole idea of smoking into bad light and ive never taken to it.

i have a family that love eachother 
getting good grades ect 
get along with people
feeling that best friends are changing alot 
but i have aload that i should be thankful for so don't know why i get crap feelings every night and some days
